theme.title: Barkley lights the Valley
theme.subtitle: Phoenix's Finals season
theme.recap: Barkley joined a new-look Phoenix team, won league MVP and led the Suns on an unforgettable title chase.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Charles Barkley's 1992–93 Suns win?
questions.note: 62 wins and the top seed in the West.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: league-best 62–20 record

funFacts.text: Barkley came from Philadelphia in a blockbuster offseason trade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Suns acquiring controversial All-Star power forward Charles Barkley from the Philadelphia 76ers

funFacts.text: Phoenix moved into America West Arena, which had seating for 19,023.

funFacts.text: The Suns introduced the Streaking Sun logo and new uniforms that season.
